verdicts.title: On the Goncharov Depth Conjecture and polylogarithms of depth two
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove the surjectivity part of Goncharov's depth conjecture. We also show that the depth conjecture implies that multiple polylogarithms of depth $d$ and weight $n$ can be expressed via a single function $\mathrm{Li}_{n-d+1,1,\dots,1}(a_1,a_2,\dots,a_d)$, and we prove this latter statement for $d=2$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Goncharov's depth conjecture about multiple polylogarithms in algebraic geometry/number theory, with no mention of Coxeter groups, Frege proofs, CNF formulas, or proof complexity. The shared word 'depth' refers to a completely different mathematical concept.

verdicts.title: On the weak order of Coxeter groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper provides some evidence for conjectural relations between extensions of (right) weak order on Coxeter groups, closure operators on root systems, and Bruhat order.
